The note does not provide an analytic micro-dataset or specify student-level sampling/replicate weights for a re-analysis; therefore, weight variables (e.g., TOTWGT or BRR/JRR) are not reported here. For users who access the underlying microdata behind the referenced tables, the OECD/ILSA sampling design should be respected by applying the official sampling weights and, where available, replicate weights for variance estimation. Because this document is not an ML study, it does not require PV-specific weighting adjustments beyond the standard complex-survey procedures used in the source indicators.

data.outcome_summary: Education at a Glance 2025 (Norway country note) synthesises education-system characteristics using the latest available indicator data, with a thematic emphasis on tertiary education. The note reports descriptive comparisons across parental education and tertiary attainment (e.g., a 43 percentage-point tertiary-attainment gap in Norway between those with and without a tertiary-educated parent), trends in unemployment by educational attainment, and differences in employment and earnings by degree level. It also summarises adult literacy proficiency from the OECD Survey of Adult Skills, including the share at or below Level 1 and the literacy score gap between tertiary-educated and upper-secondary/non-tertiary groups, plus changes between Survey of Adult Skills Cycle 1 (2012–15) and Cycle 2 (2023). Finally, it provides descriptive indicators on access and progression in tertiary education (entry pathways, gender composition, completion rates, and international student mobility) and on education financing and teacher/school organisation. No student-level ML modelling, PV estimation, or missing-data handling is performed or reported in this note.
